plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, images, annotations counts), (3) annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean), (4) category distribution (how many annotations per category), (5) image dimensions, (6) structure of metadata.json, (7) reference product images in data/products/. Log all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data properties: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Check environment and install dependencies
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Verify GPU availability and VRAM. Install any missing packages.
plan.success_criteria: All required packages available, GPU confirmed

plan.title: Install dependencies and verify GPU
plan.hypothesis: Installing torch with CUDA support will reveal GPU availability; all required packages can be installed
plan.description: Run pip install for ultralytics==8.1.0, torch==2.6.0+cu124, torchvision==0.21.0+cu124, timm==0.9.12, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Then verify torch.cuda.is_available() and print GPU info. This is critical before any training.
plan.success_criteria: All packages installed successfully, GPU status confirmed

plan.title: Create train/val split, evaluation function, and YOLO dataset
plan.description: Write scripts to: (1) Split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json (90/10, seed=42, stratified by image). (2) Implement val_score = 0.7 * detection_mAP@0.5 + 0.3 * classification_mAP@0.5 evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval. (3) Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format for both splits. Create dataset YAML config for both nc=1 and nc=356 variants.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, YOLO format labels generated, evaluation function tested

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A single-class YOLOv8m detector at 640px establishes a solid detection baseline, achieving detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.3
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=1 (all categories mapped to class 0), imgsz=640, epochs=80, batch=16. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. This establishes the detection baseline for the two-stage pipeline.

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves with small products, gaining 5+ mAP points
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=100, batch=8. Compare detection_mAP to 640px baseline.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 improves by 5+ points over 640px baseline

plan.title: Fix PyTorch weights loading and train YOLOv8m nc=1 at 640
plan.hypothesis: Monkey-patching torch.load to use weights_only=False fixes the pretrained weight loading issue, and YOLOv8m nc=1 at 640px achieves detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.30
plan.description: Add a monkey-patch at the top of main.py: override torch.load to default weights_only=False (or use torch.serialization.add_safe_globals). Train YOLOv8m nc=1 at imgsz=640, epochs=80, batch=16. This is our first working detector baseline. Use existing train/val split and YOLO format conversion code.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes without errors and detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.0 (any non-zero detection score)

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 1280 with fixed weights loading
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution (1280) improves detection_mAP@0.5 by 5+ points over 640 baseline on dense retail shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=1 at imgsz=1280, epochs=100, batch=8 with the weights loading fix. Compare detection_mAP to 640px baseline.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 improves by 5+ points over 640px baseline

plan.title: Build DINOv2 classification pipeline on GT crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base kNN classification on ground-truth val crops achieves top-1 accuracy > 30%
plan.description: Extract DINOv2-base embeddings from training crops and reference images. Build gallery, classify via cosine similarity kNN. Test on GT val crops to measure classification upper bound.
plan.success_criteria: Top-1 accuracy > 30% on GT val crops

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: best detector + DINOv2 classification end-to-end
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves val_score > 0.25
plan.description: Run best nc=1 detector on val images, crop detections, classify with DINOv2 kNN. Compute full val_score. Tune confidence threshold and kNN k.

plan.title: Detection tuning: NMS/conf sweep + SAHI tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: NMS/conf tuning and tiled inference improve detection_mAP by 3+ points
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7} and conf {0.001,0.01,0.05}. Implement SAHI tiled inference with 1280x1280 tiles. Compare to single-pass.

plan.title: Optimize classification: DINOv2-large, gallery tuning
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large + optimized gallery improves classification_mAP by 3+ points
plan.description: Test DINOv2-large, sweep k in {1,3,5,7}, compare gallery variants. Check model size fits 420MB budget.

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and val_score evaluation
plan.description: Assemble best detection + classification. Apply remaining optimizations. Run complete pipeline on val split.

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission with run.py, model weights (≤3 files, ≤420MB), gallery file. Verify sandbox compatibility. Test end-to-end.
